attributes.board_name: New Hampshire Board of Medicine (Office of Professional Licensure and Certification)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Category I meeting AMA PRA requirements or fully equivalent ones that satisfy the New Hampshire Osteopathic Association; up to 60 Category II hours. Residency/fellowship year = 50 Cat I, medically related degree = 25 Cat I
rules.alternatives: Passing an American specialty board exam (initial or recertification) = 100 Category I hours; being up to date in a maintenance of certification program counts as the full CME requirement for the preceding 2 years.
rules.audit_note: CME is tracked and reported through CE Broker (OPLC online system); keep documentation and cooperate with audits (Plc 308.04).

topics.who: Licensees required to register with the PDMP: 3 hours online CE (or an online exam) in pain management or addiction disorders; AMA PRA Cat 1/ACCME courses referencing opioid prescribing

rules.notes: One board licenses MDs and DOs. Under rule 2025-285 (adopted 7-8-26) licenses are valid 2 years from issuance; the older Med 401.01 text tied expiry to July 1 of the renewal year.
rules.legal_basis: N.H. Code Admin. R. Med 401-402 (2025-285); RSA 329
